purpose: One row per broken decision, with the suite that noticed and the case that failed. Re-runnable: node scripts/run-win272-mutations.mjs. A SURVIVOR is recorded as one and never explained away, and a mutation the compiler refuses is counted apart from a kill because a type error is evidence the type layer holds rather than evidence a case noticed.
